turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's gradebook said zero, and nobody called me.
Heard isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Two questions isn't noise. Show me what you have, or say you have nothing.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
My son doesn't lie, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing in your hand. Are you calling me a liar too? Because I can take this to the principal's office right now.
